summary: The 'LeftNav' is a part of the user interface in a web application, serving as a navigation and control panel. It encompasses various controls, including panels, labels, hyperlink buttons, link buttons, and tree views to manage navigation across different sections such as Inbox, Outbox, Reporting, Maintenance, and Help.
purpose: To provide a structured and integrated navigation interface for users within the web application, allowing easy access to various panels and functionalities such as user sessions, reporting, maintenance, and help features.

workflows.name: User Navigation and Control
steps: Activate appropriate panel or section via navigation controls.
Manage user session through login and logout functionalities.
Navigate to specific sections like Inbox, Outbox, Reporting, Maintenance, and Help using hyperlink or link button controls.
Utilize text fields for search or query functions within the application.
Access various panels to perform actions like Report viewing, Maintenance tasks, and Help retrieval.

system_behavior: Auto-generation and modification of fields are managed by moving field declarations from designer files to code-behind files.
User session management with redirect URLs after logout.
Dynamic content loading within navigation panels using content placeholders.
